posts.cooked:
Not that this helps you at all, but I received my copy of Rook City yesterday.

At Gen Con I found out Rook City and Infernal Relics were both sold out, so when I got home, I ordered them.  Amazon retailer actually canceled my Rook City order citing lack of stock and out of date store front.  So I had to turn on my eBay account which laid unused for 8 years, and get it from there.

If it makes you feel better, Spite kicked my ass big time in my first game with my own Rook City (my friend has all the sets).  He got out a turn 1 PL626 Compound XI (Spite deals 2 toxic damage to a hero who uses a power, and then Spite heals from that because well...Spite) against my self-play team of Visionary, Expat, and Fanatic, and I got rocked.  Hard.  None of his other drugs showed up until late in his deck, so I was fighting an uphill battle against his healing (I didn't get Twist the Ether until late, even though I was trying for it with Visionary).
